scope: Native release word-traversal comparison, excluding Document preparation, selection publication, browser input/paint and startup. Standalone rustc -O with release unicode-segmentation 1.13.3. Twenty interleaved samples per direction/case; outputs checked against original traversal.
limits: ASCII-run byte scans remain linear; Unicode-context queries, unindexed non-whitespace traversal and final selection publication are not bounded by this change.
